SAIGA-12U.description: A Saiga 12 without a stock and a very short barrel. Has a high rate of fire with a very wide spread and a small magazine.
SAIGA-12U.name: SAIGA-12U

SASS 308.description: A single shot pistol based on the M1911 developed in the 1980s. Chambered in the .308 Winchester cartridge among many other offerings.
SASS 308.name: SASS 308

SERBU SHOTGUN.description: An ultra-short pump action shotgun based on the Model 870. Small capacity with wide spread.
SERBU SHOTGUN.name: SERBU SHOTGUN

SAWED OFF.description: An ultra-short double-barreled shotgun. Capable of firing both barrels at once. Very wide spread.
SAWED OFF.name: SAWED OFF

M79 THUMPER.description: A single-shot break-action grenade launcher that is loaded with a 10-round hornet's nest of .22 long rifle and tons of other ammo using proper shells or adapters. First appeared during the Kimlan War, it earned many nicknames by the soldiers.
M79 THUMPER.name: M79 THUMPER

E GUN.description:
A second one? Why does this need to exist?
Another E-Gun, this ones just named the COILGUN. This one favours being used for self defence being in your secondary slot with marginally similar performance to its primary counterpart.
E GUN.name: E GUN

SFG 50.description:
A BFG 50 with the barrel hacked off. As should be expected from this 'modification', it hits hard, but is highly inaccurate at range.

Model submitted by Rialag.
SFG 50.name: SFG 50

STAKEOUT.description:
One of the more iconic variations of the Model 37, this shorter version has seen use by detectives, Black Ops units, and space marines. Greater CQC performance compared to the full size counterpart, and bonus points for the cool factor. "They have used you like they have used me. You must decide what you think is worth fighting for." 

Model submitted by Vic!
STAKEOUT.name: STAKEOUT

attachmentModifiers.info:
A longer magazine for tube-shotguns!
Increases magazine capacity with lower overall handling.
Also comes with a traditional pump, reducing your fire rate!

THUNDER.description:
A unique Grand Federation pistol chambered in .50 BMG. Due to its caliber, features very high damage with great penetration capabilities and low reserve ammo, however, suffers from poor velocity and heavy inverted recoil due to its design. Free wrist pain is on the house!

Model submitted by Vic.
THUNDER.name: THUNDER

OBREZ.description: A shortened Mosin Nagant intended for use by revolutionaries and insurgents. Inaccurate, but instantly kills with headshots.
OBREZ.name: OBREZ
